An '''astromech droid''' was present in [[Aunt Z's Tavern]] on the [[Supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'' on<ref name="The Recruit" /> the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]]<ref name="TG">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Traveler's Guide to Batuu]]''</ref> [[Castilon]]<ref name="The Recruit" /> in [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{ResistanceDate|1|1}}</ref>

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The astromech droid first appeared in the first part of "[[The Recruit]],"<ref name="The Recruit" /> the two-part premiere episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[October 7]], [[2018]].<ref name="Disney release">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref>
